title.en: Odes III.30: A Monument More Lasting than Bronze
title.zh: 颂歌第三卷第三十首：比青铜更持久

edition.en: Latin text as given on Latin Wikisource
edition.zh: 据拉丁文维基文库所录拉丁原文

basis.en: Published in 23 BCE; the poet died in 8 BCE.
basis.zh: 公元前 23 年出版，诗人卒于公元前 8 年。

note.en: Horace closed his first three books of odes with this poem, a claim that the books themselves would outlast bronze and the pyramids. It has been quoted and imitated ever since, from Ovid to Pushkin, which proves its point in a way he could not have planned. Notice how particular the promise is: he expects to be remembered by the river Aufidus near his birthplace, and for a craftsman’s achievement, bringing Greek metres into Latin.
note.zh: 贺拉斯用这首诗为他的前三卷颂歌作结，宣称这些诗卷本身会比青铜和金字塔更长久。此后从奥维德到普希金，它一再被引用和仿写，以一种他无法预先安排的方式证明了自己。留意这个承诺多么具体：他期待被记住的地方，是他出生地附近的奥菲杜斯河畔；他期待被记住的，是一项工匠式的成就——把希腊的格律带进拉丁语。

excerpt.en: I have finished a monument more lasting than bronze
excerpt.zh: 我已建成一座纪念碑，比青铜更持久

gloss.en: Libitina, the Roman goddess of funerals; undertakers kept their registers at her temple.
gloss.zh: 利比提娜，罗马掌管丧葬的女神；殡葬业者在她的神庙里登记死者。

gloss.en: The high priest and a Vestal Virgin, silent during the rite, climbing the Capitol to the temple of Jupiter for a state ceremony. Horace means: as long as Rome endures.
gloss.zh: 大祭司与一位在仪式中保持静默的维斯塔贞女，登上卡比托利欧山的朱庇特神庙举行国家祭典。意即只要罗马长存。

gloss.en: The Aufidus, today the Ofanto, a swift river of Apulia that flows past Venusia, where Horace was born.
gloss.zh: 奥菲杜斯河，今名奥凡托河，是阿普利亚的一条急流，流经贺拉斯的出生地维努西亚附近。

gloss.en: Daunus, legendary king of northern Apulia, a dry country: Horace’s home ground.
gloss.zh: 道努斯，传说中阿普利亚北部的国王；那一带干旱少水，正是贺拉斯的家乡。

gloss.en: Horace was the son of a freed slave.
gloss.zh: 贺拉斯是一位被释奴隶的儿子。

gloss.en: Aeolian song: the lyric of Sappho and Alcaeus of Lesbos, who wrote in the Aeolic dialect of Greek. Horace’s claim is to have adapted their metres to Latin.
gloss.zh: 埃奥利亚之歌，指莱斯沃斯岛的萨福和阿尔凯奥斯用希腊语埃奥利亚方言写的抒情诗。贺拉斯自许的功绩，是把他们的格律移入拉丁语。

gloss.en: Delphic: belonging to Apollo, god of poetry, whose oracle was at Delphi and whose tree was the laurel.
gloss.zh: 德尔斐的，即属于诗神阿波罗的；阿波罗的神谕所在德尔斐，月桂是他的圣树。

gloss.en: One of the nine Muses. Later she was the Muse of tragedy, but here she is simply the Muse of Horace’s lyric.
gloss.zh: 九位缪斯之一。后来专指悲剧缪斯，这里只是泛指贺拉斯抒情诗的诗神。
